scope: Seven C99 lower-layer storage, compression and external format components; source archive is offline and does not impose an application object model.

components.purpose: Block-device filesystem for NOR flash; hierarchical names, copy-on-write metadata and wear distribution.
components.selected_profile: Standard C99 implementation, per-instance callbacks; debug/warning/error printing disabled.
components.state_and_reentrancy: Mutating lfs_t/lfs_file_t instances and caller-owned block device; serialize access to each filesystem.
components.validation: VERIFICATION.json: strict C99 Linux x86_64; build from original inputs and clean retained source; other platforms and physical hardware NOT_RUN.

components.version: R0.16 + official patch 1 + patch 2 (2026-07-10) + official compact Unicode source
components.purpose: Read/write/create FAT12/16/32 and exFAT media; UTF-8 long names and Unicode case matching.
components.selected_profile: FF_USE_LFN=2; FF_LFN_UNICODE=2; FF_CODE_PAGE=437; FF_FS_EXFAT=1; FF_FS_NORTC=1; one volume; mkfs/find/fastseek/expand/chmod/label enabled.
components.state_and_reentrancy: Global volume table and mutable FIL/FATFS state; driver callbacks and serialization belong to application. LFN working buffers use stack; fixed date without RTC.
vendor_modifications: Official patches applied to ff.c, LF line endings normalized for exact patch application; patch files retained.
ffunicode.c replaced by official compact upstream Unicode table release; complete tables retained.
Selected ffconf.h materialized beside ff.h in build tree.
components.validation: VERIFICATION.json: strict C99 Linux x86_64; build from original inputs and clean retained source; other platforms and physical hardware NOT_RUN.
components.license_notes: Custom permissive ChaN license; upstream LICENSE.txt states equivalence to 1-clause BSD. GPL mentioned only as compatible downstream relicensing, not selected license.

components.purpose: Independent small flat filesystem for SPI NOR with consistency check and garbage collection.
components.selected_profile: Standard SPIFFS_CACHE=0 avoids non-C99 anonymous cache unions; magic, HAL context parameter and aligned object-index tables enabled.
components.state_and_reentrancy: Mutable spiffs context, descriptors, caller-owned block device; flat names, no directory hierarchy.
vendor_modifications: Vendor source unchanged. config/spiffs_config.h replaces test-only Linux includes with standard C types and explicit selected options.
components.validation: VERIFICATION.json: strict C99 Linux x86_64; build from original inputs and clean retained source; other platforms and physical hardware NOT_RUN.

components.purpose: Small-window streaming lossless compression and decompression.
components.selected_profile: Default dynamic-allocation API; static-allocation implementation and upstream tests retained.
components.state_and_reentrancy: Independent mutable encoder/decoder contexts; caller controls streaming and must finish/drain.
components.validation: VERIFICATION.json: strict C99 Linux x86_64; build from original inputs and clean retained source; other platforms and physical hardware NOT_RUN.

components.purpose: CBOR encoding/decoding, tags, typed extraction, decimal/bigfloat interchange tags and bounded buffers.
components.selected_profile: Default full C99 profile with floating point; standard C math library on non-MSVC.
components.state_and_reentrancy: Contexts and buffers are mutable per operation. Tagged decimals/bigfloats are data interchange, not arithmetic engines.
components.validation: VERIFICATION.json: strict C99 Linux x86_64; build from original inputs and clean retained source; other platforms and physical hardware NOT_RUN.
components.license_notes: Some older file headers add NON-INFRINGEMENT to the BSD-3-Clause warranty disclaimer; original notices retained.

components.version: CMake project 7.2, library VERSION 0.7.2; pinned snapshot
components.purpose: Independent CBOR encoding/decoding, validation and pretty printing, including binary16/32/64.
components.selected_profile: Hosted C99 CBOR API; existing software binary16 fallback; CBOR-to-JSON and memory-stream code retained but not in selected target.
components.state_and_reentrancy: Mutable encoder/parser iterators and caller-provided buffers.
vendor_modifications: Vendor source unchanged. SHA-256 guarded build view selects upstream software binary16 instead of C23 _Float16 and replaces fallthrough annotations by empty C99 statements.
components.validation: VERIFICATION.json: strict C99 Linux x86_64; build from original inputs and clean retained source; other platforms and physical hardware NOT_RUN.

components.purpose: Reader/writer of native FlashDB sector KV/time-series representation with CRC and garbage collection; LMX defines the meaning of stored data.
components.selected_profile: KVDB+TSDB, standard C FILE sector backend, no read cache; FAL hardware backend/ports retained as source but not linked.
components.state_and_reentrancy: Mutable DB handles and native sector files; caller supplies ownership and locks. libc fflush is not a proof of physical power-loss durability.
vendor_modifications: Vendor files unchanged. SHA-256 guarded build view removes non-C99 function-pointer/void* conversions. In this selected profile *_CTRL_SET_LOCK/UNLOCK receive the address of a typed callback object or NULL; this is an explicit contract difference from upstream. lmx_fdb_set_callbacks provides the direct typed alternative.
components.validation: VERIFICATION.json: strict C99 Linux x86_64; build from original inputs and clean retained source; other platforms and physical hardware NOT_RUN.
